title: Matriculation at D.A.V. Public School
content: Aman completed Matriculation at D.A.V. Public School in Malighat, Muzaffarpur, Bihar, under the CBSE board. This secondary education ran from April 2018 to March 2019.

title: Intermediate at Holy Cross Public School
content: Aman completed Intermediate education at Holy Cross Public School in Manika, Muzaffarpur, Bihar, under the CBSE board. He studied PCM: Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics, from April 2019 to March 2021.

title: B.Tech in Information Technology at Lovely Professional University
content: Aman earned a Bachelor of Technology in Information Technology from Lovely Professional University in Jalandhar, Punjab, from August 2021 to September 2025. His education included practical exposure to full-stack and Android application development, with subjects including Data Structures and Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Database Management Systems, Computer Networks, Software Engineering, and Operating Systems.
